text:
maria: Quick sync — follow-up from the token-count/delayed-ingest postmortem. I want to capture owners, short timelines, and any recurring pattern notes. Putting items here so we can track in one thread.

jonathan: +1. From eng side: root cause was the async ingest retry backpressure that queued batches for a day. Working on mitigation.

sam: FYI I re-ran the reconciliation job this morning and found ~42k tokens missing from the 2026-03-14 window vs what billing saw. SQL I used: 
```sql
SELECT day, SUM(tokens) FROM usage_raw WHERE source = 'ingest' AND day BETWEEN '2026-03-14' AND '2026-03-15' GROUP BY day;
```
I'll paste job output to the drive.

lisa: Thanks Sam. Finance needs a hard number to decide on invoice adjustments. Can we get an authoritative delta by EOD Friday?

sam: I can deliver a conservative delta (what was actually processed downstream) by Friday COB. Targeting 2026-03-27.

amy: Support saw ~12 customer tickets that mentioned unexpected high usage billing spikes — I've flagged them to FS for potential credit. Will share ticket IDs in the doc.

maria: Action items I have so far: 1) Eng owner to implement ingest backpressure fix + run backfill; 2) Billing owner to compute delta and draft invoice corrections; 3) CS owner to coordinate customer credit comms; 4) PM to track rollout and regression checks. Assigning below.

jonathan: Eng owner: jonathan -> estimate 2 sprints for fix + 1-week verification. I'll aim for canary by 2026-04-10.

sam: Billing owner: sam -> will compute delta and create adjustment spreadsheet by 2026-03-27. Also propose a script for automated drift checks weekly.

lisa: CS owner: amy -> draft comms templates and list of affected customers by 2026-03-28. Finance will sign off on credits after Sam's delta.

amy: Got it. I'll prepare two templates: one for small credits (<$500) and one for larger adjustments.

maria: PM/ops owner: lisa -> retain postmortem tasks in the remediation board and mark dependencies. Please add the recurring-pattern note: this is the 3rd time we've seen delayed ingest cause miscount (see Jan 2025, Sep 2025). We should consider a platform-level detection alert.

jonathan: Noted. For detection, proposing an automated parity check between raw ingest and downstream billing every 12 hours; flag >1% delta. I'll create a draft alert playbook by 2026-04-03.

sam: One more: invoice correction policy question — do we round to nearest dollar or prorate by token fraction? Finance input needed.

lisa: Finance prefers prorated for transparency; we'll apply caps for very small deltas to avoid churn. I'll document policy in the finance KB by 2026-03-31.

maria: OK owners/timelines summary (copy to remediation board):
- eng (jonathan): fix ingest retry/backpressure + canary 2026-04-10
- billing (sam): authoritative delta + adjustments spreadsheet 2026-03-27
- support (amy): customer lists & comms templates 2026-03-28
- finance (lisa): invoice policy doc 2026-03-31
- ops/pm (lisa + maria): add detection alert to SRE on-call playbook 2026-04-03

incidents-bot: Incident #2026-03-METER logged: remediation tasks added to board (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MTR-1234)

jonathan: I'll also add a small regression suite to CI that simulates delayed batches. If anyone wants to pair on the parity check alert let me know.

sam: Thanks — I'll upload the spreadsheet to the finance folder and ping here when ready. :white_check_mark:

lisa: Can we have a follow-up sync next week? 30m to review progress. Propose 2026-03-29 09:30 PT.

maria: 2026-03-29 09:30 PT works for me. Adding calendar invite.

amy: I'll include the list of impacted customers in the invite so we can review priority.

maria: Great. Let's use this thread for quick updates and keep the remediation board as our single source of truth. If anything slips, call it out here. :eyes:
